subject: CORRECTION: stale-shell-revision is app receipt ordering, not proof daemon rejected terminal return
body: Supersedes the causal wording in msg-rnd07-gen4-terminal-race-20261002T060644Z while retaining its source-level race finding. Deeper source/timeline check confirms Fold7CoverLeaseSnapshotGate rejects any shellRevision <= last accepted revision. In the field sequence the terminal return receipt carries shell revision 145 and state IDLE; a later reconcile carries revision 146 and state IDLE, and the app processes/accepts revision 146 before seeing revision 145. Therefore stale-shell-revision at the app does NOT prove the daemon rejected the terminal return; revision 145 strongly indicates the return mutation had already produced IDLE. What remains CONFIRMED: (1) controller reaches NATIVE_COVER at 05:35:07.774; (2) an old-cycle route-reassert receipt rev141 later reports PREWARM_IN_FLIGHT owner generation 80; (3) multiple subsequent snapshots rev142-144 remain PREWARM_IN_FLIGHT; (4) terminal return/reconcile reaches IDLE around 05:35:11.77; (5) app-side completion ordering is out of shell-revision order; (6) source allows old reassert work to remain in flight across terminal and onTopologyChanged unconditionally schedules reconcile after its fast-lane reduction. CONFIRMED SOURCE RACE WINDOW, but physical root cause remains STRONG HYPOTHESIS. Slot09 acceptance harness must record app issue seq, daemon admission decision, shell op start/end, shellRevision, controller generation, closeCycle, and handler receipt order so future traces distinguish command arrival from result delivery. Existing 100k Gen4 fuzz is sequential and cannot test this boundary.
